race.comment: WRONG ANSWER (1) has been far from disgraced in stronger races here of late including a second over this distance two back. He is very nicely placed dropping back to maiden company and should get every chance from the ace draw. SWEET BELLA ROSA NZ (8) cops a wide barrier but comes off a respectable third at her most recent appearance at Goulburn. A favourable draw could see RUSTY MUDSHARK (3) more competitive while TYPHOON LENNY (2) is on a quick back up after a fourth from the second row at Young on Tuesday. Gets his best draw so far so look for improvement.
